report.title: List of imports which are reversible
report.query: SELECT #columns# FROM imports i CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS tagged, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT o.deleted) AS remaining FROM occurrences o WHERE o.import_guid = i.import_guid ) counts WHERE i.created_by_id = #currentUser# AND i.reversible = true AND i.reversed_on IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM work_queue q WHERE q.task = 'task_import_reversal' AND q.record_id = i.id AND q.error_detail IS NULL ) AND (#website_id# = -1 OR i.website_id = #website_id#) AND i.deleted = false AND i.entity = 'occurrence' AND i.updated = 0 AND i.inserted > 0 AND COALESCE(i.global_values->>'config:allowUpdates', '0') NOT IN ('1', 'true') AND NOT jsonb_exists_any(i.global_values::jsonb, ARRAY['sample:id', 'occurrence:id']) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_path_query(i.mappings::jsonb, '$.**.warehouseField') field WHERE field IN ('"sample:id"', '"occurrence:id"') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM imports other WHERE other.import_guid = i.import_guid AND other.id != i.id ) AND i.inserted >= counts.tagged
